Container.Name: DynamicTV
Container.Overview: Watch your HDHomeRun from any browser on the network. One shared stream, transcoded once to HLS, kept in sync across every device so you can move from room to room without losing your place.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port the player is served on.

Config.Name: HDHomeRun IP
Config.Description: IP address of your HDHomeRun tuner, e.g. 192.168.1.50. Leave blank to auto-discover via SiliconDust's service (needs internet).

Config.Name: Video height
Config.Description: Output resolution height. 720 is a good CPU/quality balance, 1080 for full quality, 480 for weak hardware, 0 to keep the broadcast resolution.

Config.Name: Target latency (s)
Config.Description: Seconds behind the encoder every device plays. Raise to 8-10 on flaky Wi-Fi.

Config.Name: Auto-tune channel
Config.Description: Channel to tune when the container starts, e.g. 5.1. Leave blank to start idle.

Config.Name: x264 preset
Config.Description: Encoder speed. Use superfast or ultrafast if the CPU cannot keep up.

Config.Name: Demo channel
Config.Description: Set to 1 to add a built-in test pattern channel (works without a tuner).

Config.Name: ffmpeg video args override
Config.Description: Replaces the software encoder chain, e.g. for VAAPI or NVENC. See the README.

Config.Name: Intel/AMD GPU (VAAPI)
Config.Description: Set to /dev/dri to pass the iGPU through for hardware encoding, and fill in the ffmpeg override above.
